# cork-header

The primary site header component that accepts various slotted header components and controls their visibility in the nav tray.

By default, background images are set via global CSS properties. Without the image-url or background-image-url attributes, the header will have no background art.

The image-url and font-url attributes are conveniences for apps without a js entry point to make those calls from.
They act on the whole document, not just the header, so use one or the other, not both.

The header also sets --page-width on the document with a [`PageWidthController`](../utils/controllers/PageWidthController.md), for layout classes such as l-full-width.
Set the no-page-width attribute to turn this off.

In an SPA using @ucd-lib/cork-app-state, the header closes its open nav tray when the location changes, with an [`AppStateController`](../utils/controllers/AppStateController.md).
Set the no-app-state-close attribute to turn this off. In any other SPA, call closeNavTray() from your router on navigation.

A slotted component that opens in a nav tray can hook into it:

- When the tray opens, the header calls the component's focus(). Use delegatesFocus to pass it to the first control.
- When the tray is hidden (closed, or switched to another tray), the header calls its onNavTrayHide() method, if it has one.
- To close the open tray, it dispatches a cork-nav-tray-close-request event, with bubbles: true and composed: true.

## Properties

| Name | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `backdrop` | `String` | Campus's header bar variant, '1' (default) to '7'. Attribute: backdrop. |
| `backgroundImageUrl` | `String` | Overrides the header bar's background image, whichever backdrop is picked. Attribute: background-image-url. |
| `navTrayMenuBackgroundImageUrl` | `String` | Overrides the menu tray's background image. Attribute: nav-tray-menu-background-image-url. |
| `navTraySearchBackgroundImageUrl` | `String` | Overrides the search tray's background image. Attribute: nav-tray-search-background-image-url. |
| `navTrayQuicklinksBackgroundImageUrl` | `String` | Overrides the quick links tray's main (bottom right) background image. Attribute: nav-tray-quicklinks-background-image-url. |
| `navTrayQuicklinksAccentImageUrl` | `String` | Overrides the quick links tray's accent (top left outline) image. Attribute: nav-tray-quicklinks-accent-image-url. |
| `imageUrl` | `String` | Base URL of the theme's large images, e.g. '/images/cork-theme'. Passed to setImageCssCustomProperties(), so it sets the --cork-image-* properties for the whole document. Attribute: image-url. |
| `fontUrl` | `String` | Base URL of the theme fonts, e.g. '/fonts/cork-theme'. Passed to setFontFaces(), so it loads the fonts for the whole document. Attribute: font-url. |
| `noPageWidth` | `Boolean` | Stops the header from setting --page-width, e.g. if the app sets it itself. Attribute: no-page-width. |
| `noAppStateClose` | `Boolean` | Stops the header from closing its nav tray on cork-app-state location changes. Attribute: no-app-state-close. |
| `selectedNavComponentName` | `String` | Name of the component whose nav tray is currently open. One of the keys of _slottedComponents. |

## Slots

| Name | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `primary-nav` | Main menu. A child [`cork-primary-nav`](../elements/cork-primary-nav.md) is assigned here automatically. |
| `search` | Search. A child [`cork-search-tray`](../elements/cork-search-tray.md) (form and common searches) or a bare [`cork-search-form`](../elements/cork-search-form.md) is assigned here automatically. |
| `quick-links` | Quick links section. A child [`cork-quick-links`](../elements/cork-quick-links.md) is assigned here automatically. |
| `branding-bar` | Branding bar. A child [`cork-branding-bar`](../elements/cork-branding-bar.md) is assigned here automatically. |
| `nav-lite` | Inline main menu in the header bar, shown on larger screens in place of the menu tray toggle. A child [`cork-nav-lite`](../elements/cork-nav-lite.md) is assigned here automatically. |

## Methods

### openNavTray(name)

Opens a nav tray, closing any other. Same as setting selectedNavComponentName.

| Param | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `name` | `String` | Name of the slot whose tray to open, e.g. 'primary-nav', 'search' or 'quick-links'. |

### closeNavTray()

Closes the open nav tray, if any. Call it from an SPA's router on navigation, unless the app uses cork-app-state.

## Examples

**Import**

```js
import '@ucd-lib/cork-theme/elements/cork-header';

// or the class only, without registering the element:
import CorkHeader from '@ucd-lib/cork-theme/elements/cork-header/cork-header.js';
```

**Use**

```html
<cork-header backdrop="3">
  <cork-primary-nav>…</cork-primary-nav>
  <cork-search-form>…</cork-search-form>
  <cork-quick-links>…</cork-quick-links>
  <cork-branding-bar>…</cork-branding-bar>
</cork-header>
```

**Setting image and font origins via utility functions**

```js
// To set where fonts and images are hosted, you can call the utility functions from your app's js entry point:
import { setImageCssCustomProperties, setFontFaces } from '@ucd-lib/cork-theme/utils/assets';

// from your own app copied via 'npx cork-theme copy-images' and 'npx cork-theme copy-fonts':
setImageCssCustomProperties('/images/cork-theme'); 
setFontFaces('/fonts/cork-theme');

// or from the Library's site
setImageCssCustomProperties('https://cork-theme.library.ucdavis.edu/images');
setFontFaces('https://cork-theme.library.ucdavis.edu/fonts');
```

**Setting image and font origins via attributes**

```html
<!-- These attributes call the same utility functions, but from the header element. They act on the whole document, not just the header. -->
<cork-header
  image-url="https://cork-theme.library.ucdavis.edu/images"
  font-url="https://cork-theme.library.ucdavis.edu/fonts">
  <cork-primary-nav>…</cork-primary-nav>
</cork-header>
```

**Overriding images**

```html
<!-- replaces the header bar's and the menu tray's background images, for this header only -->
<cork-header
  background-image-url="/images/my-header-bar.webp"
  nav-tray-menu-background-image-url="/images/my-menu-tray.webp">
  <cork-primary-nav>…</cork-primary-nav>
</cork-header>
```

**Custom slotted element**

```html
<!-- any element can fill a slot with the slot attribute, in place of the cork element -->
<cork-header>
  <cork-primary-nav>…</cork-primary-nav>
  <div slot="branding-bar" class="my-branding">
    <a href="/">My Site</a>
  </div>
</cork-header>
```

## Typedefs

### SlottedComponent

Typedef: `Object`

#### Properties

| Name | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `name` | `String` | The slot's name, as used in the slot attribute (e.g. 'primary-nav'). |
| `ele` | `HTMLElement\|null` | The light DOM child currently assigned to the slot, or null if there is none. |
| `corkComponentName` | `String\|String[]` | Tag name of the cork element that is assigned to this slot automatically (e.g. 'cork-primary-nav'). An array accepts any of the tags, checked in order, e.g. ['cork-search-tray', 'cork-search-form']. Only one element is assigned. |
| `navTrayName` (optional) | `String` | Name of the nav tray that this component toggles, if any (e.g. 'menu'). |
| `defaultAttributes` (optional) | `Object` | Default attributes to apply to the component if not found as properties or attributes on the element itself. |
| `label` (optional) | `String` | Human readable label for the component |
| `showLabelInNavTrayBar` (optional) | `Boolean` | Whether to show the label in the nav tray bar. |
